name: @shepherd/ext-tasks
description: shepherd.tasks — a task is intent plus 1..n repos plus the sessions working them; worktrees, never copies.
//exports: The agents-core split: main imports ./manifest to register, the utility process imports the root. ./model is a THIRD subpath for the pure layer — the task vocabulary, the root synthesis and the git decisions — so a consumer reaching it does not pull in `activate`.
//shepherd: The manifest, as an extension declares it. `src/manifest.ts` is the typed copy the host loads, and `manifest.test.ts` asserts the two are identical.
//ui: The UI half, imported ONLY by the renderer (boundaries.js). It is a separate subpath because it is a separate PROCESS: `.` is the service half and runs in a utility process with no DOM, and react must not follow it there.
